author: 狄金森
profile: 美国隐居女诗人，短章精警，写希望、死亡、孤独与真理，意象奇崛而口吻俏皮。适合内向主角的心声、生死题材的点题短句、小众人物的自我认同。
source: 文本据 1890–1896 年 Todd 与 Higginson 编本及 1945 年 Bolts of Melody 初刊文本，只收英文原文。

entries.title: Hope is the thing with feathers
entries.text:
Hope is the thing with feathers
That perches in the soul,
And sings the tune without the words,
And never stops at all,

And sweetest in the gale is heard;
And sore must be the storm
That could abash the little bird
That kept so many warm.

I've heard it in the chillest land,
And on the strangest sea;
Yet, never, in extremity,
It asked a crumb of me.
famous_lines: Hope is the thing with feathers
And sings the tune without the words
drama_uses: 绝境中仍抱希望的旁白
片名或集名：有羽毛的希望
entries.note: 据 1891 年编本。 英文原文为公有领域；中译本多数仍在版权期，剧中使用请自行翻译或化用。

entries.title: Because I could not stop for Death
entries.text:
Because I could not stop for Death,
He kindly stopped for me;
The carriage held but just ourselves
And Immortality.

We slowly drove, he knew no haste,
And I had put away
My labor, and my leisure too,
For his civility.

We passed the school where children played,
Their lessons scarcely done;
We passed the fields of gazing grain,
We passed the setting sun.

We paused before a house that seemed
A swelling of the ground;
The roof was scarcely visible,
The cornice but a mound.

Since then 'tis centuries; but each
Feels shorter than the day
I first surmised the horses' heads
Were toward eternity.
famous_lines: Because I could not stop for Death
drama_uses: 主角临终的马车意象蒙太奇

entries.title: I'm nobody! Who are you?
entries.text:
I'm nobody! Who are you?
Are you nobody, too?
Then there's a pair of us — don't tell!
They'd banish us, you know.

How dreary to be somebody!
How public, like a frog
To tell your name the livelong day
To an admiring bog!
drama_uses: 两个边缘人物结盟的台词

entries.title: If I can stop one heart from breaking
entries.text:
If I can stop one heart from breaking,
I shall not live in vain;
If I can ease one life the aching,
Or cool one pain,
Or help one fainting robin
Unto his nest again,
I shall not live in vain.
famous_lines: If I can stop one heart from breaking
I shall not live in vain

entries.title: Tell all the truth but tell it slant
entries.text:
Tell all the truth but tell it slant —
Success in Circuit lies
Too bright for our infirm Delight
The Truth's superb surprise
As Lightning to the Children eased
With explanation kind
The Truth must dazzle gradually
Or every man be blind —
famous_lines: Tell all the truth but tell it slant
